messages:
maria: Heads up — after yesterday's proxy batch change, quota dashboard is showing ~2x token usage for some clients. Saw it in tenant U-17 on console.

lin: saw alerts. It lines up with the new batching window (0.2s -> 1s). Proxy aggregates requests pre-auth and we may be double-counting when it retries.

dylan: can you paste the logs / example request ids?

maria: logs: ```2026-03-22T21:02:12Z proxy: batch_id=ba_3a req_id=abc123 tenant=U-17 tokens=320 retry_of=none``` ```2026-03-22T21:02:12Z quota-service: charge tenant=U-17 tokens=640 source=proxy``` — looks like quota-service receives both the batched sum and the per-request charge.

lin: probable cause: proxy now forwards charging for each sub-request + a summary envelope. I think the envelope used `X-Route-Source: proxy-batch` but quota dedupe only looked at `req_id`. `retry_of` gets set, but not normalized.

simon: @maria @lin tagging eng-platform. This could affect billing + customer alerts. Can we rollback the proxy batching change on canary?

maria: Canary is live in prod-1 and prod-2. I can rollback prod-2 now, need approval for prod-1 (affects 35% traffic).

dylan: rollback prod-2 first. Also let's add telemetry: emit `x-charge-marker` header with unique batch_id so quota-service can dedupe.

lin: agree. Quick patch: proxy stop emitting per-request quota header when sending batch envelope (PATCH ready). I'll open PR.

devex: heads-up, need to update SDK docs: client libraries may see higher reported usage if your app uses our default proxy. We'll add note in 'billing gotchas' and recommend disabling batching if customers want strict per-request accounting.

maria: ops-bot scheduled rollback for prod-2 at 21:45 - I kicked it. @dylan can you monitor p95/consumption in console? :eyes: 

dylan: watching. p95 latency unaffected. consumption in prod-2 dropped ~47% after rollback. Looks like double-charge gone for canary subset.

lin: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/proxy/pulls/412 — changes: remove per-request quota header when batch=true, add `x-charge-marker: ba_<id>` and docs. Plan to roll canary fix to all regions after QA.

simon: +1. Also let's add a console metric to detect charge dupes: compare `quota.charged_tokens` vs `observed.tokens` at tenant level — alert if ratio >1.2.

maria: created ticket RD-8472 with roll-forward plan and doc updates. Will follow up.
